content.rendered:
?

Exo. 33v14 GNB
The Lord said, “I will go with you, and I will give you victory.”
?
When God gives His Word, He has a lot at stake.. His integrity, His faithfulness, His “everything” are all at stake.

When God says He will go with you and give you victory, then nothing, I repeat, nothing can stand in the way of your victory.

?Today?
✔You will have victory over that long standing issue.
✔You will have victory over that setback.
✔You will have victory over sickness.
✔You will have Victory over that which has forced your head into a defeated position.
?
Today will be an unusual day for you.✔
You will return home with songs of victory✔

God will overwhelm you with an avalanche of reasons to celebrate in Jesus name
